title: narcissus triandrus subsp. calathinus
intro: Narcissus triandrus subsp. calathinus, commonly known as Poet's Narcissus, is a species of bulbous perennial plant within the Amaryllidaceae family. It is known for its drooping, bell-shaped flowers and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues and as a natural expectorant. The plant has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus triandrus subsp. calathinus include alkaloids, such as galantamine, which have been studied for their potential neuroprotective effects and other biological activities.
